purpose: Notation-only conversion of the supplied technical appendices. These checks do not establish correctness of the underlying arguments.
preserved: Original source expressions, operator order, explicit grouping, local equation tags and unresolved source wording are retained in the transcription map.
api: convert_expr(source: str, appendix: str | None = None) -> str returns a LaTeX math body. Use appendix="d" for Appendix D prose to resolve its local D0 alias. convert_display(source, block_id) uses the appendix from block_id.

source_locations: Line numbers refer to the unchanged Markdown files in technical_notes, using appendix letters a–j.
